In time-dilated HIL the GPU fallback result carried only the GPU latency (244 ms) although the frame was available only after the 1.0 s primary timeout; the stall's frame-age cost was hidden. FailoverBackend now reports max(secondary latency, total call time); unit test added.

Orphaned project processes (matrix python + its ssh session to the RNGD server) terminated; CARLA lock left stale (owner PID dead, taken over automatically).
